subject: Align Label in Legend with end value of geom_line

messages.author: 334d5e0a5ee5bb44
messages.subject: Align Label in Legend with end value of geom_line
parts:
I am creating a plot with multiple geom_line geoms. I have a two part question.

1) is there a better way to annotate the last value of each geom_line
geom than using annotate the way I am below?

2) is there a way to line up the label of each geom_line in the legend
with the actual line? I'm including an example of what is currently
plotted and the desired output that
was hacked together by cropping the legend with an image editor.

Thanks

#create data frame
x<-seq(1, 100)
y<-seq(1, 100)
df<-data.frame(y1=y*0.25, y2=y*0.5, y3=y,y4=y*2,y5=y*3,x=x)
x<-NULL
y<-NULL

# holds colors and label values
myvalues<-c("y1"="green", "y2"="orange", "y3"="yellow", "y4"="blue",
"y5"="black")

#create plots with 5 lines
p <-ggplot(df, aes(x))
p <- p + opts(title="Labels In Legend Not Aligned") +xlab("x") + ylab("y")
p <- p + geom_line(aes(y=y1, colour="y1")) + annotate("text",
label=format(df$y1[100], nsmall=1), x=df$x[100], y=df$y1[100])
p <- p + geom_line(aes(y=y2, colour="y2")) + annotate("text",
label=format(df$y2[100], nsmall=1), x=df$x[100], y=df$y2[100])
p <- p + geom_line(aes(y=y3, colour="y3")) + annotate("text",
label=format(df$y3[100], nsmall=1), x=df$x[100], y=df$y3[100])
p <- p + geom_line(aes(y=y4, colour="y4")) + annotate("text",
label=format(df$y4[100], nsmall=1), x=df$x[100], y=df$y4[100])
p <- p + geom_line(aes(y=y5, colour="y5")) + annotate("text",
label=format(df$y5[100], nsmall=1), x=df$x[100], y=df$y5[100])
p <- p + scale_colour_manual(name="", values=myvalues)
p

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: Align Label in Legend with end value of geom_line
parts:
Hi,
You can get pretty close using directlables:

dat <- melt(df, measure.vars = grep("y", names(df)))
dat <- ddply(dat, .(variable), transform, variable = paste(variable,
value[length(value)]))
p <-ggplot(dat, aes(x = x, y = value, colour = variable)) +
geom_line() +
xlim(min(dat$x), max(dat$x + 10))
library(directlabels)
direct.label(p, method = "last.points")

Not exactly what you asked for, but maybe close enough.

Best,
Ista
